app.title: Lafia Chat AI — Munyambulizi w'ebyobulamu ow'ekyama
consent.title: Ekifo ekikuumi ku bibuuza by'amazima go.
consent.subtitle: Lafia munyambulizi w'ebyobulamu eri abakyala n'abawala. Buuza ku mubiri gwo, okutunga, olubuto, enkola y'okuzaala n'obulamu — mu lulimi lwo.
consent.promise1Body: Tetubuuza linnya lyo, nnamba ya ssimu oba imeyilo.
consent.promise2Body: Tewali kintu kitera kusigibwa okuggyako osalawo okukisiga ku kifaananyi kino.
consent.promise3Body: Kozesa Fuluma amangu oba sangula emboozi zo ekiseera kyonna.
consent.notDiagnosis: Ntegeera nti Lafia awa amawulire ag'obulamu aga bulijjo so si kulamula ndwadde.
consent.emergencyNote: Mu mbeera ey'akabenje, tuukirira omukisa w'ebyobulamu oba obuyambi bw'akabenje amangu.
consent.quickExitHint: Amagezi: nyiga Escape emirundi ebiri okufuluma amangu.
chat.welcomeSubtitle: Mbuuza ku byonna ebikukwatako mu bulamu. Nnaaddamu okuva mu bulagirizi bwa WHO era ndaga ensibuko.
chat.suggestion1: What are the danger signs in pregnancy?
chat.suggestion2: What contraception options are available to me?
chat.suggestion3: How can I manage period pain?
chat.suggestion4: I feel anxious — where can I get support?
chat.sourcesEmpty: Sources will appear here after an answer.
chat.saveChats: Tereka emboozi zange ku kifaananyi kino
chat.saveChatsHint: Off by default. Saved only in this browser, never on the server.
chat.deleteConfirm: Delete all chats stored in this browser?
chat.savingOff: Saving off. Stored chats were deleted.
chat.pressEscAgain: Press Escape again to leave Lafia.
chat.disclaimer: Lafia awa amawulire ag'obulamu aga bulijjo, so si kulamula ndwadde. Ku bubonero obw'akabenje, noonya obujjanjabi amangu.
chat.voiceUnavailable: Listen is unavailable for this language in your browser.
chat.micUnsupported: Voice input is not supported in this browser.
chat.quickExitAria: Quick exit Lafia and open a neutral site
privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.noAccountBody: You can use every feature without signing in. We never ask for your name, phone number or email.
privacy.saveTitle: Save my chats on this device
privacy.saveBody: Off by default. When on, chats are stored only in this browser using local storage. They are never sent to our server.
privacy.deleteBody: This removes chats stored in this browser. It cannot be undone.
privacy.quickExitBody: Pressing Quick exit or Escape twice opens a neutral site and clears this session. The Back button will not return to Lafia.
privacy.locationBody: Find care uses your location once, in your browser, to sort nearby facilities. It is never sent or stored.
care.title: Zuula obujjanjabi okumpi nange
care.subtitle: These are placeholder facilities. Replace them with verified local services before launch.
care.locationUnsupported: Location is not available in this browser.
care.locationHint: Ekifo kyo kikozesebwa omulundi gumu ku kifaananyi kino era tekikumibwa oba kuterekebwa.
care.chwBody: Saba essimu ey'okuddamu okuva ku mukisa w'ebyobulamu ow'ekitundu.
care.chwNotConnected: Call-back requests are not connected in this prototype.
care.emergencyNote: Placeholder emergency number. Verify the correct local number before launch.
care.placeholderNote: All names, numbers and hours below are placeholders. They must be replaced with verified local services.
care.locationAria: Use my location to sort facilities by distance
